normalizedResponse.intent: defend oracle-sensitive positions against Chainlink deviation correction within 6-minute liquidation window
normalizedResponse.reasoning: Oracle-sensitive exposure = $12M (Aave stETH loop) + $8M (Compound borrow) + $5M (Uniswap V3 LP) = $25M. Hedged perps ($6M) and stables ($4M) are excluded. Expected loss avoided = current deviation × oracle-sensitive exposure protected = 0.048 × $25,000,000 = $1,200,000. Six-minute defense: (1) Minutes 0-2: Unwind Aave stETH leverage loop—repay debt, withdraw stETH collateral to eliminate $12M liquidation risk. (2) Minutes 2-4: Reduce Compound ETH collateral—repay borrow or withdraw excess collateral to safe LTV on $8M position. (3) Minutes 4-6: Withdraw Uniswap V3 LP liquidity and convert to stable or off-chain hedge for $5M exposure. All actions target protecting full $25M oracle-sensitive exposure before the oracle committee corrects and liquidation risk materializes.
